description: Local-first search, resume, handoff, usage tracking, and bulk session management for AI coding sessions.
notes: This package follows the customized nonlog/Recall fork rebased on upstream v0.5.8.
TUI source branding keeps distinct colors/icons with Unicode fallbacks.
Delete moves selected/current sessions to Recall trash; Ctrl+D permanently deletes them. Bulk selection uses Insert, Ctrl+Space, or Space while the search box is empty.
The trash directory is persisted by Scoop across upgrades.
The bottom shortcut bar follows upstream; Ctrl+S Settings shows the complete keyboard shortcut reference.
rx includes upstream harness aliases rxc/rxx/rxo/rxp/rxd/rxk for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, DeepSeek Harness, and Kimi Code.
